gltf_coordinates.conversion: [x,y,z] -> [x,z,-y]; yaw about source Z -> glTF Y

robot_pose: source teleop_home static joint configuration, normalized to base group

editable_nodes.robot: robot_base_pose; x, -z, rotation.y map to source x, y, yaw
editable_nodes.tray: tray_pose; x, -z, y, rotation.y map to source x, y, z, yaw

recolor_policy: Only mesh extras.editableColor robot/tray; robot targets original silver shell surfaces. Clone materials before per-room edits.
room_fidelity: Photo-inspired approximate arrangement; no measured room survey or exact reconstruction claim
limitations: Exact current server scene_mechanics_v2 USD/XML was not present locally; this is source-parent geometry and current batch registered initial pose. Live articulation state is not streamed.
Browser preview has no physical contacts, dynamics, camera sensor output, task success or training qualification.
Source room is photo-inspired, not a measured reconstruction; background includes decorative office desks distinct from the three physical task tables.
Floor procedural grain texture and engine lighting are not reproduced; geometry and base material colors are preserved.
32 rooms may reuse shared geometry but need separate materials for per-room recoloring; all current registered room poses are available in the backend snapshot.
